items.question: How many products are in the catalog?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE discontinued_on IS NULL) AS currently_sold_count FROM products;

items.question: Which countries do we sell to in Asia Pacific?
items.sql: SELECT c.code AS country_code, c.name AS country_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(r.net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd FROM order_revenue r JOIN countries c ON c.code = r.country_code WHERE r.region_code = 'APAC' AND r.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND r.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY c.code, c.name ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC

items.question: How many support tickets are still open or pending?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_or_pending_tickets FROM support_tickets WHERE status IN ('open', 'pending')

items.question: What was total net revenue in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd_2025 FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

items.question: What is the average net order value in 2026 so far?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS average_net_order_value_usd, COUNT(*) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01';

items.question: How many customers do we have in each region?
items.sql: SELECT region_code, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer_profile GROUP BY region_code ORDER BY customer_count DESC

items.question: How much subscription revenue did we invoice and collect in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_usd), 2) AS invoiced_usd, COUNT(*) AS paid_invoices FROM subscription_revenue WHERE issued_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND issued_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'

items.question: What was net revenue by product category in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT category_name, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue FROM order_line_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

items.question: How many delivery support tickets did each EU country have in calendar Q3 2026?
items.sql: SELECT COALESCE(o.country_code::text, 'unknown') AS country_code, COUNT(*) AS delivery_tickets FROM support_tickets t JOIN regions r ON r.id = t.region_id AND r.code = 'EU' LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = t.order_id WHERE t.category = 'delivery' AND t.created_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01 00:00:00+00' AND t.created_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY COALESCE(o.country_code::text, 'unknown') ORDER BY delivery_tickets DESC, country_code

items.question: What net revenue was attributed to each campaign for orders in 2026, by campaign name?
items.sql: SELECT c.name AS campaign_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_revenue o JOIN campaigns c ON c.id = o.campaign_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY net_revenue_usd DESC;

items.question: What was the average resolution time in hours of support tickets by region in 2026?
items.sql: SELECT r.code AS region_code, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t.resolved_at - t.created_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 2) AS avg_resolution_hours, COUNT(*) AS resolved_tickets FROM support_tickets t JOIN regions r ON r.id = t.region_id WHERE t.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND t.created_at < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY r.code ORDER BY avg_resolution_hours DESC

items.question: Show monthly net revenue for the last 12 months
items.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS date) AS month_start, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-10-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

items.question: What was net revenue in the first half of 2026?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01'

items.question: What was net revenue in the last 90 days?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd_90d, DATE '2026-07-03' AS period_start, DATE '2026-09-30' AS period_end FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-07-03' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01'

items.question: What was net revenue by region last calendar quarter vs the one before?
items.sql: SELECT region_name AS region, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd END), 0), 2) AS q2_2026_net_revenue, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd END), 0), 2) AS q3_2026_net_revenue, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd END), 0), 2) AS difference_usd, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN net_revenue_usd END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd END), 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN net_revenue_usd END), 0), 0), 4) AS pct_change FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY q3_2026_net_revenue DESC

items.question: How did the number of orders in each region change between calendar Q2 2026 and Q3 2026?
items.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT region_code, CASE WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-07-01' THEN 'q2' WHEN ordered_at >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01' THEN 'q3' END AS period FROM order_revenue WHERE ordered_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND ordered_at < DATE '2026-10-01'), agg AS (SELECT region_code, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE period = 'q2') AS q2_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE period = 'q3') AS q3_orders FROM base GROUP BY region_code) SELECT region_code, q2_orders, q3_orders, q3_orders - q2_orders AS diff_orders, ROUND((q3_orders - q2_orders)::numeric / NULLIF(q2_orders, 0), 4) AS pct_change FROM agg ORDER BY region_code

items.question: What was the refund rate in each region in 2025 compared with 2026 so far?
items.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT region_code, SUM(refund_usd) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01') AS refunds_2025, SUM(gross_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01') AS gross_2025, SUM(refund_usd) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01') AS refunds_2026, SUM(gross_revenue_usd) FILTER (WHERE order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01') AS gross_2026 FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-10-01' GROUP BY region_code), c AS (SELECT region_code, refunds_2025 / NULLIF(gross_2025, 0) AS rr_2025, refunds_2026 / NULLIF(gross_2026, 0) AS rr_2026 FROM r) SELECT region_code, ROUND(rr_2025, 4) AS refund_rate_2025, ROUND(rr_2026, 4) AS refund_rate_2026_ytd, ROUND(rr_2026 - rr_2025, 4) AS change_pts, ROUND((rr_2026 - rr_2025) / NULLIF(rr_2025, 0), 4) AS pct_change FROM c ORDER BY region_code

items.question: Which 10 products had the most units sold in 2026 so far?
items.sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, SUM(units) AS units_sold FROM order_line_revenue WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY product_id, product_name ORDER BY units_sold DESC, product_id LIMIT 10

items.question: Which campaign had the largest budget?
items.sql: SELECT c.id AS campaign_id, c.name AS campaign_name, c.start_date AS start_date, c.end_date AS end_date, ROUND(c.budget_usd, 2) AS budget_usd FROM campaigns c ORDER BY c.budget_usd DESC, c.id LIMIT 1

items.question: Which customers placed the most orders in 2025? Show the top 5, including anyone tied with the fifth.
items.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_rank FROM counts) SELECT customer_id AS customer_id, order_count AS order_count, order_rank AS order_rank FROM ranked WHERE order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY order_rank, customer_id

items.question: Of the customers whose first order was in January 2025, how many ordered again within 90 days of that first order?
items.sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, first_order_at FROM customer_profile WHERE first_order_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND first_order_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-02-01 00:00:00+00'), repeat_customers AS (SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id FROM cohort c JOIN order_revenue o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.ordered_at > c.first_order_at AND o.ordered_at <= c.first_order_at + INTERVAL '90 days') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS cohort_customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repeat_customers) AS repeat_customers, ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repeat_customers)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 0), 4) AS repeat_rate_90d

items.question: What share of customers who signed up in 2024 placed at least one order in 2026?
items.sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_profile WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'), active AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM order_revenue o JOIN cohort c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2027-01-01') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS cohort_customers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active) AS ordered_in_2026_customers, ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 0), 4) AS share_ordered_in_2026

items.question: What was the net revenue after refunds of the Aurora Smart Bulb (Gen 1) products in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(olr.net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_after_refunds_usd FROM order_line_revenue olr WHERE olr.product_name ILIKE '%aurora%' AND olr.product_name ILIKE '%bulb%' AND olr.product_name ILIKE '%gen%1%' AND olr.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND olr.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';

items.question: Among products with at least 100 units sold in 2025, which one had the highest refund rate?
items.sql: WITH product_2025 AS (SELECT product_id, product_name, SUM(units) AS units_sold, SUM(gross_revenue_usd) AS gross_revenue, SUM(refund_usd) AS refund_total FROM order_line_revenue WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY product_id, product_name) SELECT product_id, product_name, units_sold, ROUND(gross_revenue, 2) AS gross_revenue_usd, ROUND(refund_total, 2) AS refund_usd, ROUND(refund_total / NULLIF(gross_revenue, 0), 4) AS refund_rate FROM product_2025 WHERE units_sold >= 100 ORDER BY refund_rate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1;

items.question: What was net revenue in USD from customers in Japan in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd FROM order_revenue WHERE country_code = 'JP' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

items.question: How much money did we receive in USD from successful order payments in September 2026?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount * fx.usd_per_unit), 2) AS received_usd, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN fx_rates fx ON fx.currency_code = p.currency_code AND fx.rate_date = CAST(p.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS date) WHERE p.status = 'succeeded' AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(c.is_test_account, false) = false AND p.paid_at >= DATE '2026-09-01' AND p.paid_at < DATE '2026-10-01';

items.question: How many customers do we have?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE first_order_at IS NOT NULL) AS customers_with_orders FROM customer_profile

items.question: What was net revenue in North America in March 2024?
items.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_usd), 2) AS net_revenue_usd FROM order_revenue WHERE region_code = 'NA' AND order_date >= DATE '2024-03-01' AND order_date < DATE '2024-04-01'

items.question: How many orders in 2025 had no campaign attribution?
items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unattributed_order_count
FROM order_revenue
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND campaign_id IS NULL;

items.question: How many customers have no known acquisition channel?
items.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE acquisition_channel IS NULL) AS customers_without_channel, COUNT(*) AS total_customers, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE acquisition_channel IS NULL)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS share_without_channel FROM customer_profile

items.question: At which local hour of the day did APAC customers place the most orders in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.ordered_at AT TIME ZONE r.timezone)::int AS local_hour, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE r.code = 'APAC' AND c.is_test_account = false AND o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.ordered_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY order_count DESC

items.question: Count every combination of an order item with every other order item
items.sql: WITH lines AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_line_revenue) SELECT n AS order_item_count, (n * (n - 1)) / 2 AS unordered_item_pairs FROM lines

items.question: Show the subject and text of the most recent support ticket
items.sql: SELECT subject AS ticket_subject, body AS ticket_body FROM support_tickets ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
